test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 15 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: which of the following is NOT a Himalayan Mountain Pass connecting Uttarakhand with Tibet?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shipki La**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shipki La** is not a Himalayan Mountain Pass connecting Uttarakhand with Tibet.
 
• It is located on the **India-China border** between **Himachal Pradesh and Tibet**.
 
• Shipki La is one of the major passes through which trade between India and Tibet takes place.
 
• The pass is known for its strategic importance and is located near the** Sutlej river**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Niti Pass**, **Mana Pass**, and **Mangsha Dhura** are all mountain passes connecting **Uttarakhand with Tibet**.
 
• **Niti Pass** is located in the Chamoli district of Uttarakhand.
 
• **Mana Pass** is also located in the Chamoli district and is one of the highest vehicle-accessible passes in the world.
 
• **Mangsha Dhura** is lesser-known but also serves as a connection between Uttarakhand and Tibet.
 
• These passes have historical and strategic significance and are used for trade and pilgrimage.
